normalized_matching_profile.name: Searenity Now
normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents…“Searenity Now”, where the Gulf meets pure bliss! This 3-suite Seagrove Beach condo sleeps 8 and invites you in endless ocean views from wall-to-wall windows. Picture mornings on a private beach, evenings biking with 4 beach bikes along 30A, and meals shared in a stunning Chef's kitchen. With cozy touches and adventure steps away, it’s more than a stay—it’s a memory waiting to happen. Between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, your perfect escape starts here! Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf front corner unit with expansive views – Wake up to breathtaking panoramic ocean views, where the shimmering waves meet the horizon in an unforgettable display.Private beach access and seasonal on-site beach setup (2 chairs & 1 umbrella) – Step straight onto the soft, sandy shores with your own private beach access—complete with a stress-free setup for pure relaxation.Spacious wraparound balcony for sea breezes & sunsets – Savor tranquil evenings and golden sunsets as the ocean breeze surrounds you on the generous wraparound balcony.Sleeps 8 with 3 bedrooms, each with en-suite bathrooms – Perfect for family or friends, this home offers comfort and privacy with three cozy bedrooms, each featuring its own en-suite sanctuary.Recently renovated with updated Chef's kitchen and modern finishes – Enjoy a fresh, contemporary vibe with a fully updated kitchen and sleek, modern touches throughout the space.4 bikes included to explore scenic 30A trails – Explore the charm of 30A on beach bikes, cruising through picturesque trails and discovering hidden gems along the way.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “Absolutely stunning view and unbeatable beach access! The condo was immaculate and spacious, comfortably accommodating our family of 8. Couldn't have asked for more!” – Chandra C.⭐ “Hands down the best vacation we’ve ever had! The breathtaking balcony views and sleek, modern interiors made our stay unforgettable. Already planning to return next year!” – Susie M.⭐ “Everything was perfect—location, design, and top-notch amenities, just as advertised. The ultimate beach getaway!” – Lindsey H.*** LIVING AREA ***Step into a stunning, light-filled, open-concept living space that perfectly blends luxury and comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows offer breathtaking, uninterrupted views of the Gulf, flooding the room with natural light and creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. Every detail, from the modern furnishings to the calming palette, has been curated to create the ultimate retreat for relaxation and style.Breathtaking wall-to-wall Gulf views that will leave you in aweThoughtfully curated modern furnishings and a serene ambianceSeamless access to a stunning wraparound balcony offering panoramic vistas*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Whether you're hosting a dinner party or savoring a relaxed breakfast, this updated Chef's kitchen is designed to impress. Featuring stunning leathered granite countertops and top-of-the-line amenities, it has everything you need to create culinary magic. The spacious dining area comfortably seats 8, while the oversized island offers additional seating for 4—perfect for casual gatherings or lively conversations while you cook.Sleek stainless steel appliances paired with luxurious granite countertops for a modern, high-end feelSpacious dining table comfortably seating 8, complemented by an island with seating for 4—ideal for entertainingPerfectly designed for hosting group meals, family gatherings, or relaxed casual dining experiences*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step outside into your very own private oasis, where relaxation and enjoyment become second nature. Comfortable beach chairs and a shaded wraparound balcony create the ultimate spot for soaking up the sun or enjoying a peaceful afternoon with a book.Wraparound Balcony: Start your mornings with a cup of coffee on the spacious wraparound balcony, complete with ample seating and stunning views.Outdoor Adventures: Discover miles of scenic 30A biking trails with 4 beach bikes, or try kayaking, paddleboarding, and hiking at nearby Grayton Beach and Deer Lake State Parks.Relaxed Atmosphere: A quiet, family-friendly neighborhood offering both relaxation and proximity to vibrant coastal activities.*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ***Whether you're traveling with friends, family, or little ones, the thoughtfully crafted bedroom layout ensures the ideal blend of space, unparalleled comfort, and ultimate privacy. Every detail has been designed to cater to everyone's needs, creating a haven where relaxation and togetherness seamlessly come together.Primary King Suite: King Bed, balcony access and private En-suite with soaking tub, oversized walk-in shower, and dual sinksQueen Guest Suite: Queen Bed with En-suite complete with a single sink and glass-enclosed showerBunk Room: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, perfect for kids, with an En-suite with a single sink and shower/tub combo.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Tucked between the charming towns of Seaside and Rosemary Beach, Seagrove Beach is a serene coastal haven that perfectly balances relaxation and convenience. With its sugar-white sands just steps away, this peaceful neighborhood offers a tranquil escape while keeping you close to boutique shops, award-winning restaurants, and vibrant local attractions. Whether you're seeking quiet moments by the shore or adventures in nearby towns, Seagrove Beach is the perfect destination for a coastal retreat.Private Beach Access: Step onto Seagrove’s powdery white sand beaches and soak up the tranquility of your own seaside retreat.Rosemary Beach: A sophisticated, European-inspired town with cobblestone streets, upscale shops, and a romantic atmosphere.Seaside: A charming coastal town with boutique shops, gourmet dining, and a laid-back, friendly vibe. Perfect for a relaxed afternoon stroll.Grayton Beach State Park: Explore unspoiled nature with hiking trails, kayaking, and stunning views—ideal for outdoor enthusiasts.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Low-speed vehicles are NOT allowed per HOA rules.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210164
